planlar.metin: [surprised] Simitlerim yine yok! Kim aldı bunları?!
planlar.gorsel: Vertical 9:16 frame, medium close-up of the shop owner facing the camera, mouth clearly visible, shocked wide eyes, holding up a completely EMPTY wooden simit tray with only a few sesame seeds on it; the glass case of his red simit cart behind him is EMPTY. Historic Bursa cobblestone street. Levent and Cemo are NOT in the frame.

planlar.metin: [excited] Korkmayın Hasan Amca, Bursa Dedektifleri burada!
planlar.gorsel: Vertical 9:16 frame, medium close-up of Levent facing the camera, mouth clearly visible, confident detective pose holding a big round magnifying glass up next to his face, a brown detective deerstalker hat on his head, red simit cart blurred behind him.

Vertical 9:16 frame, extreme close-up from above of grey cobblestones: a trail of sesame seeds leads away from the red cart wheel, and a single small white-grey bird feather lies on the stones; the edge of a big round magnifying glass is held over the clues. No faces.
planlar.hareket: The magnifying glass slowly moves along the sesame seed trail and stops over the white feather.
planlar.efekt: magnifying glass whoosh and a soft mysterious detective sting

planlar.metin: [whispers] Abi şüpheli çok: çaycı, kedi, bir de ben...
planlar.gorsel: Medium close-up of Cemo facing the camera, mouth clearly visible, resting his heavy video camera on his shoulder with a sleepy, hungry expression.

planlar.metin: [laughs] Sen değilsin Cemo, ağzında susam yok!
planlar.gorsel: Medium close-up of Levent facing the camera, mouth clearly visible, pointing enthusiastically forward with an ingenious smile.

Vertical 9:16 frame, a cheeky chubby cartoon seagull with big expressive eyes sits on top of an old iron street lamp, a whole golden sesame simit in its beak, looking guilty at the camera; historic Bursa rooftops and Uludağ mountain behind. No people.
planlar.hareket: The seagull freezes, its eyes dart left and right guiltily, then it gulps the simit.
planlar.efekt: seagull squawk and a comic gulp sound

planlar.gorsel: Vertical 9:16 frame, medium close-up of Levent facing the camera, mouth clearly visible, surprised and amused, pointing up with one hand while holding the magnifying glass in the other, wearing the brown detective deerstalker hat; red simit cart blurred behind him.

planlar.metin: [laughs] Madem öyle, martıya özel simit köşesi açıyorum!
planlar.gorsel: Medium close-up of the shop owner facing the camera, mouth clearly visible, beaming with joy while holding two traditional tulip-shaped glasses of steaming tea.

Vertical 9:16 frame, wide shot of a LONG cheerful queue of at least fifteen customers lined up across the cobblestone square in front of the red glass simit cart; the shop owner hands out simits; at the side a small wooden sign reads 'MARTI KÖŞESİ' next to a little dish where the chubby seagull happily eats a simit. Ulu Cami and Uludağ in the background.
planlar.hareket: The queue shuffles forward happily while the seagull nibbles its own simit on the little dish.
planlar.efekt: lively crowd chatter, coins clinking and a happy seagull squawk

planlar.metin: [excited] Abi video patladı, herkes simit kuyruğunda!
planlar.gorsel: Medium close-up of Cemo facing the camera, mouth clearly visible, raising his smartphone showing skyrocketing viral social media counters.

planlar.metin: [excited] Sıradaki vaka hangi dükkânda? Yorumlara yazın, takip edin!
planlar.gorsel: Medium close-up of Levent facing the camera directly, mouth clearly visible, presenting with his microphone and giving an enthusiastic thumbs up.
